name: Calicut Cubing Gambit 2026

venue.name: Finprov Learning Centre, Kozhikode
venue.address: 4th Floor, Golden Plaza, Mavoor Rd, opposite KSRTC Bus Stand

information:
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
* Participants must bring their own cubes.

**On The Spot Registration**
* On The Spot (OTS) Registration has been enabled for this competition **If** 40 competitors have not completed online registration
* All OTS Registrants have to come on time and follow the schedule
* OTS Registration is only available from **8:30 AM to 9:00 AM**
* OTS Registration is only avaible for **3x3, 3x3OH, Skewb**
